n_input = int(input())

MODULUS = 10**9 + 7
groups = [[] for _ in range(9)]
popcount_counts = [0] * (1 << n_input)
probabilities = [0] * n_input
aux = [0] * n_input
dp_states = [dict() for _ in range(n_input + 1)]

for index_i in range(1 << n_input):
    index_j = bin(index_i).count('1')
    popcount_counts[index_i] = len(groups[index_j])
    groups[index_j].append(index_i)

dp_states[0][1] = 1

for index_i in range(n_input):
    probs_input = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for j in range(n_input):
        probabilities[j] = probs_input[j] * 570000004 % MODULUS

    for state, value in list(dp_states[index_i].items()):
        for k in range(n_input):
            aux[k] = 0
        for m in groups[index_i]:
            if ((state >> popcount_counts[m]) & 1) != 0:
                for j in range(n_input):
                    if ((m >> j) & 1) == 0:
                        aux[j] |= (1 << popcount_counts[m | (1 << j)])
        for mask in range(1 << n_input):
            product_val = 1
            sum_val = 0
            for j in range(n_input):
                if ((mask >> j) & 1) != 0:
                    sum_val |= aux[j]
                    product_val = (product_val * probabilities[j]) % MODULUS
                else:
                    product_val = (product_val * (MODULUS + 1 - probabilities[j])) % MODULUS
            dp_states[index_i + 1][sum_val] = (dp_states[index_i + 1].get(sum_val, 0) + value * product_val) % MODULUS

print(dp_states[n_input].get(1, 0))
